label: HTTPS on 443, TLS ends here with the site certificate
code:
- name: https
  protocol: HTTPS
  port: 443
  tls:
    mode: Terminate
    certificateRefs:
      - name: ricerocket-tls

label: Plain HTTP on 80, kept only to redirect
Send every plain HTTP request to its https:// URL
code:
- filters:
    - type: RequestRedirect
      requestRedirect:
        scheme: https
        statusCode: 301

label: /api and every path below it, to the api without /api
code:
- matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /api
  filters:
    - type: URLRewrite
      urlRewrite:
        path:
          type: ReplacePrefixMatch
          replacePrefixMatch: /
  backendRefs:
    - name: api
      port: 80

label: Every other path, to the web app
code:
- matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /
  backendRefs:
    - name: web
      port: 80

label: /api and every path below it, to the api without /api
code:
- matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /api
  filters:
    - type: URLRewrite

label: /api and every path below it, to the api without /api
code:
